title: Linear Equations in Several Variables
description: What makes an equation linear and what a solution to a system of linear equations means geometrically.
mastery_criteria: Student can recognise a linear equation and describe the solution set of a small system geometrically.

title: Representing Systems as Augmented Matrices
description: How to encode a linear system compactly as an augmented matrix.
mastery_criteria: Student can convert between a system of equations and its augmented matrix form.

title: Gaussian Elimination
description: Using row operations to reduce a matrix to row-echelon form and solve the system.
mastery_criteria: Student can perform Gaussian elimination to reach row-echelon form and back-substitute.

title: Reduced Row-Echelon Form
description: Extending elimination to reduced row-echelon form and reading solutions directly.
mastery_criteria: Student can produce reduced row-echelon form and classify a system as unique, infinite or no solution.

title: Matrix Addition & Scalar Multiplication
description: The basic algebra of matrices: adding, scaling, and when these operations are defined.
mastery_criteria: Student can add and scale matrices and state the dimension rules for these operations.

title: Matrix Multiplication
description: How to multiply matrices and why the operation is defined the way it is.
mastery_criteria: Student can multiply conformable matrices and explain why multiplication is not commutative.

title: Identity & Inverse Matrices
description: The identity matrix and what it means for a square matrix to have an inverse.
mastery_criteria: Student can define the identity and inverse and verify that a given matrix is an inverse.

title: Computing the Inverse by Elimination
description: Finding a matrix inverse using Gauss-Jordan elimination on an augmented identity.
mastery_criteria: Student can compute the inverse of a small matrix via row reduction and know when it fails to exist.

title: Determinants of Small Matrices
description: Computing 2x2 and 3x3 determinants and their geometric meaning as area and volume scaling.
mastery_criteria: Student can compute 2x2 and 3x3 determinants and interpret the sign and magnitude.

title: Properties of Determinants
description: How row operations affect the determinant and the link between a zero determinant and invertibility.
mastery_criteria: Student can predict how a determinant changes under row operations and connect det = 0 to singularity.

title: Vector Spaces & Subspaces
description: The axioms of a vector space and how subspaces sit inside them.
mastery_criteria: Student can verify whether a set with given operations is a vector space or subspace.

title: Linear Independence
description: When a set of vectors is linearly independent and how to test it.
mastery_criteria: Student can determine whether vectors are linearly independent using elimination.

title: Basis & Dimension
description: How a basis spans a space with independent vectors and defines its dimension.
mastery_criteria: Student can find a basis for a subspace and state its dimension.

title: Eigenvalues & the Characteristic Equation
description: What an eigenvalue is and how to find it from the characteristic polynomial.
mastery_criteria: Student can set up and solve the characteristic equation to find eigenvalues of a small matrix.

title: Eigenvectors & Eigenspaces
description: Finding the eigenvectors associated with each eigenvalue and the eigenspace they span.
mastery_criteria: Student can compute eigenvectors for a given eigenvalue by solving the null space of A minus lambda I.

title: Diagonalization
description: When a matrix can be diagonalized and why diagonal form makes powers and dynamics easy.
mastery_criteria: Student can decide whether a matrix is diagonalizable and construct the diagonalizing change of basis.
